answer: The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in wander, expire in walnut, and trellis lists each expiry. An attacker running 63 aliases as a result needs 118 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4658 identities would post 4217 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
